ble.reconnectFallback: Tap Connect to reconnect to your Bluetooth sensor.

ble.noDecoderFallback: Connected to this device, but {appName} doesnʼt have a decoder for it yet. Live data is unavailable.

freeRow.title: Free row
freeRow.placeholder: Live sensor data will appear here once data starts flowing.

recording.armed: Tap Start to begin recording. Your row will be saved as a FIT file you can upload to Strava, Training Peaks, or Garmin Connect.
recording.savedBody: Saved {duration} of rowing with {strokes, plural, one {# stroke} other {# strokes}}. Share it to upload to Strava or Training Peaks.
recording.savedDisclosure: Speed and pace are estimated by RowerM8.
recording.saveErrorBody: Something went wrong while saving the FIT file. Try again.
recording.discardBody: This will delete the recording without saving. This canʼt be undone.
recording.shortActivityBodyFewStrokes: Only {count, plural, one {# stroke} other {# strokes}} were detected. Do you want to keep it or discard it?
recording.shortActivityBodyShortDuration: The activity is only {durationSeconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} long. Do you want to keep it or discard it?
recording.shortActivityBodyBoth: Only {count, plural, one {# stroke} other {# strokes}} in {durationSeconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}. Do you want to keep it or discard it?
recording.shareUnavailable: Sharing isnʼt available on this device.

pauseBanners.inactivityBody: We paused the recording because we didnʼt see any strokes for a few minutes. Tap Resume to keep going, or Stop to save what you have.
pauseBanners.backgroundPhoneBody: Phone-only motion canʼt record in the background. Tap Resume to keep recording, or pair a Bluetooth motion sensor next time so the activity continues when the screen is off.

foregroundService.title: RowerM8 — recording
foregroundService.body: Recording your activity. Tap to return to RowerM8.

inactivityReminder.title: Are you still rowing?
inactivityReminder.body: We havenʼt seen any strokes for a few minutes. Open RowerM8 to save or discard your activity.

recovery.title: Resume your activity?
recovery.bodyResumable: We saved {duration} of rowing with {strokes, plural, one {# stroke} other {# strokes}} from {ageMinutes, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}. Resume to keep recording, or save what you have.
recovery.bodyExpired: We saved {duration} of rowing with {strokes, plural, one {# stroke} other {# strokes}} from {ageMinutes, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}. Itʼs older than the {resumeWindowMinutes}-minute resume window, so you can save or discard it.
